entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to request identification parameters from the UE.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network containing the requested identification parameters.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is connected to the network.

entities.name: identification parameters
entities.description: Parameters containing UE identification information as requested by the network.

relations.description: Receipt of IDENTITY REQUEST message triggers the UE to send IDENTITY RESPONSE message.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message contains the identification parameters requested by the network.
UE must be in EMM-CONNECTED mode to respond to IDENTITY REQUEST message.
